title: Node Login
empty: No nodes need to log in. Tailscale nodes are supported for now.
unsupported: The current core does not support node login. Please upgrade the core.
loadFailed: Failed to read the node status: {{error}}

notes.shared: Shares its device identity with {{name}} of the current profile
notes.pendingSettings: Settings of this profile, which take effect after switching to it: {{settings}}
notes.controlServerDiffers: The control server differs; you may need to log in again after switching
notes.conflict: Several nodes of the current profile share this device identity: {{names}}
notes.inactive: Not active; switch to this profile to see its status and log in
notes.invalid: The core does not allow the state-dir of this node (only paths under the core's working directory and SAFE_PATHS); fix the config
notes.keyExpired: The key has expired: log in again to renew it, or log out and log in to another account with an auth key
notes.needsApproval: Waiting for the admin of the control server to approve the device
notes.failed: Fix the problem, then reload the config (for example, apply the current profile again)

login.title: Log in {{name}}
login.sharedTitle: Log in {{name}} of the current profile (shares its device identity with {{node}} of {{profile}})
login.keySection: Log in with an auth key
login.keyNote: The auth key is used for this login only and is not saved
login.linkNote: Open the link in a browser to finish logging in. With Headscale without OIDC, the page shows a command to run on the server to register the device. The node shows as logged in here once done.
login.approval: Waiting for the admin of the control server to approve the device; it shows as logged in once approved

logout.title: Log out
logout.sharedTarget: This logs out {{name}} of the current profile (which shares its device identity with {{node}} of {{profile}})
logout.effect: Connections through this node will fail until it logs in again
logout.ephemeral: This is an ephemeral node: the device will be removed from the control server
logout.configAuthKey: The config of this node sets an auth-key, so it logs in again automatically the next time it starts

errors.timeout: No result yet; check the status of the node later
errors.changed: The node has changed; please try again
errors.loggedIn: The node has a device identity; log it out before logging in with an auth key
